notes.title: Changelog - New Version
notes.content: [h3]🔧 [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where enemy aura effects could stack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect attack range display of the [b]Artillery[/b] tower.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect display of potion limit.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]⚔️ General Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Elite waves will no longer drop monster souls.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Immolation skill:[/b] changed[/p][list][*][p][b]Old:[/b] Deals armor-piercing damage = (Strength * 0.6/1.2/1.8/2.2) per second.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New:[/b] Deals armor-piercing damage = (Strength * 0.4/0.8/1.2/1.4) every half second.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]🏰 Tower Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Mithril King:[/b] Passive skill now deals an additional 50%/100%/150% damage to stunned enemies at each level.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lord Slayer:[/b] Passive skill, damage increase based on enemy’s lost HP is capped at 100%/200%/300% per level.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Navy Rifleman:[/b] Passive skill, attack boost effect changed from 30%/45%/60% to 50%/75%/100%.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Elven Arcanist:[/b] Passive skill, increased number of linked towers from 1/2/3 to 2/4/6.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where enemy aura effects could stack.
Fixed incorrect attack range display of the Artillery tower.
Fixed incorrect display of potion limit.

tags.balance_change: Immolation skill: Deals armor-piercing damage = (Strength * 0.4/0.8/1.2/1.4) every half second.
Mithril King: Passive skill now deals an additional 50%/100%/150% damage to stunned enemies at each level.
Lord Slayer: Passive skill, damage increase based on enemy’s lost HP is capped at 100%/200%/300% per level.
Navy Rifleman: Passive skill, attack boost effect changed from 30%/45%/60% to 50%/75%/100%.
Elven Arcanist: Passive skill, increased number of linked towers from 1/2/3 to 2/4/6.

notes.title: Changelog - New Version
notes.content: [h3]⚙️ System Updates[/h3][list][*][p]Added chat system in the lobby.[/p][/*][*][p]Added display of player status: online/in battle.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🔧 General Updates[/h3][list][*][p]Aura effects from passive skills can no longer stack.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]10 extra seconds[/b] in the unlock challenges for [b]Pharaoh[/b] and [b]Overlord[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Immolation[/b] skill:[/p][list][*][p]Damage range increased from [b]720 → 750[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Now unaffected by [b]magic damage[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Damage now [b]ignores armor[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Elite waves[/b] now drop [b]gold + wood + monster souls[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to purchase [b]Empty Vial[/b] for [b]40 monster souls[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the limit of [b]elixirs[/b] from [b]300 → 500[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3]📜 Quest Updates[/h3][list][*][p]Reduced completion condition for [b]Arcanis[/b] quest from [b]20% → 15%[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The completion conditions of cooperative quests will be adjusted (based on the number of players) at the start of each wave.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Added chat system in the lobby.
Added display of player status: online/in battle.

tags.balance_change: Aura effects from passive skills can no longer stack.

tags.feature: Added 10 extra seconds in the unlock challenges for Pharaoh and Overlord.

tags.balance_change: Damage range increased from 720 → 750.
Now unaffected by magic damage.
Damage now ignores armor.

tags.feature: Elite waves now drop gold + wood + monster souls.
Added the ability to purchase Empty Vial for 40 monster souls.

tags.balance_change: Increased the limit of elixirs from 300 → 500.
Reduced completion condition for Arcanis quest from 20% → 15%.
The completion conditions of cooperative quests will be adjusted (based on the number of players) at the start of each wave.

notes.title: Changelog - New Version
notes.content:
[h3]🔧 Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the leaderboard displayed missing players.[/p][/*][/list][h3]⚙️ General Updates[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted to increase the appearance rate of towers from the Arcanis realm.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the spawn health of One-eyed Wizard to 85%.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🏰 Tower Updates[/h3][p][b]Red Demon[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted passive skill [b]Molten Fist[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Now deals damage to the designated target and surrounding targets within a radius of 280.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased damage scaling from:

to

\[(Intelligence * 10) + 200]
to

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where the leaderboard displayed missing players.

tags.balance_change: Adjusted to increase the appearance rate of towers from the Arcanis realm.
Adjusted the spawn health of One-eyed Wizard to 85%.
Now deals damage to the designated target and surrounding targets within a radius of 280.

Increased damage scaling from:
[(All Stats * 2/4/6) * number of negative effects on the designated target]
to
[(All Stats * 3/6/9) * number of negative effects on the designated target].

Reduced the damage of [b]Darkness Signet Burst[/b] from
[(Intelligence * 10) + 200]
to
[(Intelligence * 7) + 280].

tags.feature: Added playground changes when unlocking [b]Background: Grakthorn[/b].

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where Realm Gems were not received from upgraded skins.
Fixed an issue where rewards from [b]One-eyed Wizard[/b] were not displayed.

tags.balance_change: Adjusted the [b]Extreme[/b] difficulty and expanded difficulty settings.
[b]Increased Soul Gems gained in all difficulties.[/b]
Bronze Tier Tower: (tower level * 2) mastery points
Silver Tier Tower: (tower level * 2) mastery points
Gold Tier Tower: (tower level * 2) mastery points
Bronze Tier Tower: (tower level * 3) mastery points
Silver Tier Tower: (tower level * 5) mastery points
Gold Tier Tower: (tower level * 7) mastery points
Each player has 2 charges.

notes.title: Heroic Aegisio: Origins Enters Playtest Phase – Sign Up Now
notes.content: [h3]📢 JOIN THE PUBLIC PLAYTEST FOR [b]HEROIC AEGISIO: ORIGINS[/b]![/h3][p][/p][p]We’re excited to invite you to the [b]Public Playtest[/b] of [b][i]Heroic Aegisio: Origins[/i][/b]![/p][p]This is your chance to experience the game early, help us improve it, and become part of our growing community.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Playtest Schedule[/b][/h3][list][*][p]📅 [b]Start Date:[/b] July 23, 2025[/p][/*][*][p]⏳ [b]Duration:[/b] Approximately 2 weeks[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]What to Expect in the Playtest[/b][/h3][list][*][p]✨ [b]5 x Loot Rewards[/b] available throughout the test[/p][/*][*][p]🎯 [b]3 x Strategic Points[/b] to help you grow stronger[/p][/*][*][p]🎁 [b]Special Event[/b]: Bonus rewards for your first 7 wins[/p][/*][*][p]♻️ [b]All progress will be reset[/b] after the playtest ends.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Exclusive Rewards for Testers[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🎖️ [b]Steam Achievement[/b] Show off that you were part of the public test wave![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]💬 [b]Special Discord Role[/b] Join the discussion and stand out in the community.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]🌟 [b]Get Credited in the Game[/b] Outstanding contributors (feedback, suggestions, or donations) will be listed in the official game credits.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]How to Join[/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Go to the [b][i]Heroic Aegisio: Origins[/i][/b] Steam store page.[/p][/*][*][p]Click [b]“Request Access”[/b] to enter the playtest.[/p][/*][*][p]Install the game and dive in![/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][h3][b]Join Our Discord[/b][/h3][p]Discuss strategies, report bugs, and share your thoughts:[/p][p]👉 [url="https://discord.gg/4JDqWZRVBU"]https://discord.gg/4JDqWZRVBU[/url][/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for helping us bring [b][i]Heroic Aegisio: Origins[/i][/b] to life. Your voice matters — and this is only the beginning.[/p][p]See you on the battlefield! ⚔️[/p]
